description: This source file defines the CameraCaptureService actor for managing camera and video capture functionalities on macOS, including listing devices, taking pictures, recording, handling permissions, and exporting videos. It includes nested types for camera information, errors, and delegate classes for photo and video capture.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class handling photo capture callbacks and passing image data or errors back to the caller.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class managing the completion and error handling of video recording.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available camera devices with their information.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with specified options asynchronously, returning image data and size.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip asynchronously, handling audio inclusion and output path.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests camera or microphone access permissions.

methods.name: availableCameras
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices.

methods.name: externalDeviceType
methods.description: Returns the device type for external cameras if available.

methods.name: pickCamera
methods.description: Selects an appropriate camera device based on facing direction and device ID.

methods.name: normalizeSnap
methods.description: Normalizes snapshot parameters like maxWidth and quality.

methods.name: exportToMP4
methods.description: Exports a recorded video to MP4 format asynchronously.

methods.name: waitForExposureAndWhiteBalance
methods.description: Waits until auto exposure and white balance have stabilized.

methods.name: sleepDelayMs
methods.description: Delays execution for a specified duration in milliseconds.
